items.zh: 这单词我背了五遍，第二天还是忘，正常吗？
items.scene: 睡前合上单词书，跟室友吐槽

answers.en: I've gone over this word five times and I still forget it the next day — is that normal?
answers.note: 用现在完成时讲反复背的经历，末尾问 is that normal，像在求安慰，适合熟人之间吐槽。

answers.en: Does this happen to you too? I keep learning this word and losing it overnight.
answers.note: 先反问对方是否也这样，把话题抛回去，语气更轻松，适合想找人共鸣时。

answers.en: Is it normal to forget a word the day after you learn it?
answers.note: 只问现象是否普遍，不交代自己背了几遍，语气最客观，适合问老师或学习搭子。

items.zh: 你一天背多少个单词？我总是一口气背一百个，然后全忘。
items.scene: 午休时问旁边也在背单词的同事

answers.en: How many words do you memorize a day? I do a hundred at once and forget them all.
answers.note: 先问对方再自嘲，语气日常，适合同事之间交换方法。

answers.en: What's your daily word count? I knock out a hundred in one sitting and forget every one.
answers.note: knock out ... in one sitting 是口语说法，强调一口气突击，自嘲更重。

answers.en: Do you set a daily word goal? I tried a hundred a day and none of it stuck.
answers.note: word goal 指每天的目标量，none of it stuck 强调没记住，语气偏无奈，适合备考的人。

items.zh: 单词书买了两本，一本都没翻完，还有救吗？
items.scene: 你指着桌上落灰的单词书，跟室友自嘲

answers.en: I bought two word books and haven't finished either one — am I hopeless?
answers.note: am I hopeless 自嘲最重，适合熟人之间开玩笑。

answers.en: Is it just me, or does everyone buy word books and never finish them?
answers.note: Is it just me 把问题说成普遍现象，带找共鸣的意味，语气轻松。

answers.en: I've got two vocabulary books and haven't gotten through one. Any advice?
answers.note: Any advice 把自嘲转成求建议，语气认真，适合问学长或老师。

items.zh: 我单词都认识，一开口就卡住，这毛病怎么改？
items.scene: 口语课后留下来问老师

answers.en: I know the words, but I freeze the moment I start speaking — how do I fix that?
answers.note: freeze 指当场卡壳，how do I fix that 直接求方法，适合课后单独问老师。

answers.en: My words disappear as soon as I open my mouth. What should I do?
answers.note: words disappear 夸张描述卡壳，What should I do 更像求助，语气偏着急。

answers.en: Is there a way to stop freezing when I speak? The words just won't come out.
answers.note: 先问有没有办法，再补一句话到嘴边说不出来，语气较克制，适合不想显得抱怨时。

items.zh: 周末英语角你去吗？我一个人不敢开口。
items.scene: 周五下班前，你问同组同事

answers.en: Are you going to English corner this weekend? I get nervous speaking on my own.
answers.note: 先问对方去不去再讲自己的顾虑，语气自然，适合约同事同行。

answers.en: You heading to English corner Saturday? I need someone to break the ice with.
answers.note: break the ice 指有人先带开口，说法随意，适合关系近的同事。

answers.en: Is anyone from the team going to English corner? I'd feel better going with someone.
answers.note: 在工作群里问有谁去，I'd feel better 说得含蓄，适合不想显得太紧张时。

items.zh: 刚才那句话我说错了，现在想起来还脸红。
items.scene: 下班路上跟朋友复盘白天口语课

answers.en: I said the wrong thing in class earlier — I still cringe thinking about it.
answers.note: cringe 是年轻人常用口语，强调回想时的尴尬，适合朋友间吐槽。

answers.en: I messed up a sentence earlier and I'm still embarrassed about it.
answers.note: messed up 语气比 cringe 平和，still embarrassed 直接说难为情，适合跟普通同学说。

answers.en: What I said earlier came out wrong, and I can't stop thinking about it.
answers.note: came out wrong 指话说得不合适，只陈述加反复回想，语气最淡，适合跟不熟的人提一句。

items.zh: 美剧不开字幕我一句都听不懂，是我太差了吗？
items.scene: 跟室友窝在沙发上看剧，你按下暂停

answers.en: I can't catch a single line without subtitles — am I that bad?
answers.note: catch a line 指听清台词，am I that bad 带自嘲，适合室友之间。

answers.en: Without subtitles I'm completely lost. Is my listening really this weak?
answers.note: completely lost 强调完全跟不上，语气比上一句更沮丧。

answers.en: Do native speakers really talk this fast? I can't follow without subtitles.
answers.note: 把听不懂归因于语速，用反问带惊讶，适合边看边感叹。

items.zh: 听力考试前两题永远走神，怎么让自己集中？
items.scene: 备考时跟学习搭子视频，你说起老毛病

answers.en: I always zone out on the first two questions of the listening test — how do I stay focused?
answers.note: zone out 指走神，how do I stay focused 直接问方法，适合学习搭子。

answers.en: Any tips for not drifting off at the start of the listening section?
answers.note: drift off 也指走神，比 zone out 温和，Any tips 语气客气，适合问老师。

answers.en: Why do I always lose focus right when the listening starts?
answers.note: 用 Why do I 自问，带懊恼，偏抱怨，适合跟熟人发牢骚。

items.zh: 地铁上戴耳机听英语，坐过站两次了，值得吗？
items.scene: 早上到公司，你跟同事讲昨天的糗事

answers.en: I listen to English on the subway and I've missed my stop twice — is it worth it?
answers.note: 先讲事实再反问 is it worth it，带自嘲，适合早上跟同事闲扯。

answers.en: Should I keep listening to English on my commute? I've ridden past my stop twice.
answers.note: 用 Should I keep 征求建议，把糗事当论据，语气认真。

answers.en: Two missed stops later, I'm starting to doubt this subway listening plan.
answers.note: Two missed stops later 像讲故事开头，语气最轻松，适合熟人之间。

items.zh: 我 th 这个音总发成 s，别人听得出来吗？
items.scene: 发音课上被老师点名后，你小声问同桌

answers.en: I keep saying th like an s — can people tell?
answers.note: can people tell 问别人听不听得出来，语气有点心虚，适合问同桌。

answers.en: Does my th sound like an s? I can't hear the difference myself.
answers.note: 先问发音像不像，再说自己听不出来，语气更坦白，适合问老师。

answers.en: Is my th coming out as an s? People have mentioned it before.
answers.note: 用 People have mentioned 说明别人提过，语气平静，适合确认老问题。

items.zh: 英音和美音我混着说，会不会听起来很怪？
items.scene: 跟同学练口语，对方笑你口音跳来跳去

answers.en: I mix British and American pronunciation — does it sound weird?
answers.note: 直接问会不会怪，语气随意，适合同学之间随口确认。

answers.en: Is it a problem that my accent switches between British and American?
answers.note: 用 Is it a problem 问严重程度，语气更认真，适合问老师。

answers.en: Does it sound jarring when I switch accents mid-sentence?
answers.note: jarring 指听着突兀、不顺耳，更在意听感，适合被笑过之后问。

items.zh: 外教上课语速太快，我要不要让他慢一点？
items.scene: 下课后你在教室门口犹豫，问同学

answers.en: Our teacher speaks really fast — should I ask him to slow down?
answers.note: should I ask 直接问要不要提，适合跟同学商量。

answers.en: Is it okay to tell the teacher he's going too fast for me?
answers.note: Is it okay to tell 更在意合不合适，语气谨慎。

answers.en: Would it be rude to ask the teacher to speak more slowly?
answers.note: 用 Would it be rude 担心失礼，最客气，适合问学长学姐。

items.zh: 外教夸我口语进步大，我该怎么回才不尴尬？
items.scene: 下课外教拍你肩膀夸了一句，你愣住

answers.en: My English teacher complimented my speaking today — how do I respond without making it awkward?
answers.note: 直接把难题说出来，respond without making it awkward 是口语说法，适合问朋友。

answers.en: What's a good way to reply when the teacher compliments my speaking?
answers.note: 用 What's a good way 问方法，不预设尴尬，语气更中性，适合问同学或学长。

answers.en: The teacher said my speaking's gotten a lot better. How do I answer that without sounding awkward?
answers.note: 先复述老师的夸奖再问怎么接，带点为难，适合跟朋友细说。

items.zh: 英语角里没人理我，是我话题太无聊吗？
items.scene: 活动结束回宿舍，你跟室友复盘

answers.en: Nobody talked to me at English corner — was my topic that boring?
answers.note: 用 that boring 反问他是不是话题太闷，自嘲里带委屈，适合跟室友说。

answers.en: I couldn't get a conversation going at English corner — is it me?
answers.note: is it me 把原因归到自己身上，带自我怀疑，语气更含蓄，适合复盘时随口问。

answers.en: Did I come off as boring at English corner? People kept drifting away.
answers.note: come off as 指给人什么印象，drifting away 描述别人慢慢走开，语气更克制。

items.zh: 第一次去英语角，开场白说点啥不会冷场？
items.scene: 周六下午出门前，你给朋友发语音

answers.en: It's my first time at English corner — what should I say to start a conversation?
answers.note: 直接问开场说什么，语气务实，适合问有经验的朋友。

answers.en: Any icebreaker ideas for my first English corner?
answers.note: icebreaker 指破冰话题，问法简短随意，适合熟人之间。

answers.en: What's a safe topic for my first English corner? I don't want to blank out.
answers.note: 问稳妥话题并说怕脑子空白，顾虑具体，适合有点紧张时。

items.zh: 看美剧学英语，到底该不该开中文字幕？
items.scene: 晚上和室友争论看剧方式

answers.en: Should I use Chinese subtitles when I watch American shows to learn English?
answers.note: 完整问句把目的说清，语气认真，适合跟室友讨论。

answers.en: Chinese subs or no subs for learning — what do you do?
answers.note: 用二选一反问，subs 是口语缩写，适合快速交换意见。

answers.en: Is it cheating to watch with Chinese subtitles?
answers.note: 用 cheating 半开玩笑地质疑，语气轻松，适合熟人抬杠。

items.zh: 这部剧我追了三季，剧情全靠字幕，白看了？
items.scene: 周末窝在家里刷完一季，你发微信给朋友

answers.en: I've watched three seasons and followed it all through subtitles — did I waste my time?
answers.note: followed it all through subtitles 指全程靠字幕，结尾直问是否白看，语气懊恼。

answers.en: Three seasons in and I still can't watch this show without subtitles.
answers.note: 只陈述现状不提问，语气无奈，适合发朋友圈式吐槽。

answers.en: Is binge-watching with subtitles even helping my English?
answers.note: binge-watching 指刷剧，even 加强质疑，语气最冲。

items.zh: 室友看美剧从来不开字幕，他听力真那么强？
items.scene: 你跟另一个朋友聊起室友

answers.en: My roommate watches American shows with no subtitles at all — is his listening really that good?
answers.note: no subtitles at all 强调他完全不开字幕，结尾半信半疑，适合跟朋友八卦。

answers.en: How does my roommate watch American shows without any subtitles?
answers.note: 用 How does 表达佩服，语气带惊讶，适合感叹。

answers.en: Is my roommate just pretending he doesn't need subtitles?
answers.note: 直接怀疑对方在装，语气最八卦，适合熟人之间开玩笑。

items.zh: 背单词 App 的会员值得开吗？一年要三百多。
items.scene: 午休时同事推荐你开会员，你拿不定主意

answers.en: Is the premium version of this vocab app worth it? It's over three hundred a year.
answers.note: premium version 指会员版，先问值不值再报价格，语气务实。

answers.en: Would you pay that much a year for the premium plan?
answers.note: 用 Would you pay 把问题抛回对方，更口语，适合征求同事意见。

answers.en: Does the paid version actually help, or is the free one enough?
answers.note: 把付费版和免费版对比着问，带怀疑，适合不想花冤枉钱时。

items.zh: App 每天提醒我打卡，我关了通知，这样是不是废了？
items.scene: 晚上躺床上，你跟室友说自己关了提醒

answers.en: I turned off the app's daily reminders — does that mean I've given up?
answers.note: 先讲关提醒再问是不是放弃，语气自嘲，适合跟室友说。

answers.en: Is it bad that I muted the streak reminders?
answers.note: mute 指关掉通知，streak 指连续打卡，问法简短，适合随口确认。

answers.en: The app kept nagging me to check in, so I turned off notifications — am I sabotaging myself?
answers.note: nagging 指不停催，sabotaging myself 带自嘲，适合吐槽 App 又有点心虚。

items.zh: 时态我背得滚瓜烂熟，一写就全乱，怎么办？
items.scene: 语法课后你拦住老师问

answers.en: I know the tenses cold, but my writing is a mess — what should I do?
answers.note: know ... cold 指背得极熟，my writing is a mess 说写起来乱，适合问老师。

answers.en: Why do my tenses fall apart as soon as I write a sentence?
answers.note: fall apart 强调一写就散，Why do 带困惑，语气更急。

answers.en: Is there a way to make tense rules stick when I write?
answers.note: make rules stick 指让规则记牢，问法较克制，适合不想显得基础差时。

items.zh: 语法书看到虚拟语气就卡住了，要不要跳过去？
items.scene: 自习室里你指着书问同学

answers.en: I'm stuck on the subjunctive in this grammar book — should I skip it?
answers.note: stuck on 指卡住，should I skip it 直接问，适合同学之间。

answers.en: Is it okay to skip the subjunctive chapter for now?
answers.note: 用 for now 留余地，语气谨慎，适合问老师。

answers.en: Do I really need the subjunctive? I keep getting stuck there.
answers.note: 先质疑要不要学，再解释卡住，语气带抵触，适合吐槽。

items.zh: 我学英语断断续续三年了，还是停在原地。
items.scene: 深夜翻到三年前的打卡记录，给朋友发消息

answers.en: I've been learning English on and off for three years and I'm still stuck in the same place.
answers.note: on and off 指断断续续，stuck in the same place 说没进步，语气无奈。

answers.en: Three years of starting and stopping English — and I'm back at square one.
answers.note: back at square one 指回到起点，语气更重，带自嘲。

answers.en: Does starting and stopping for three years even count as learning?
answers.note: 用反问质疑自己算不算在学，语气最消极，适合跟好友倾诉。

items.zh: 每天只学二十分钟，坚持下去有用吗？
items.scene: 你刷到学习博主的视频，转头问同事

answers.en: Is twenty minutes a day actually enough to make a difference?
answers.note: make a difference 指有没有效果，问法直接，适合问同事。

answers.en: Can twenty minutes a day really add up to anything?
answers.note: add up to 强调日积月累，带怀疑，语气更口语。

answers.en: Will I see progress if I only study twenty minutes a day?
answers.note: 用 Will I see progress 关心结果，语气务实，适合认真规划时。

items.zh: 打卡一百天了，感觉还是没什么长进，要不要停？
items.scene: 晚上看着打卡日历，你问一起学的朋友

answers.en: I'm a hundred days into my streak and I don't feel any better — should I stop?
answers.note: streak 指连续打卡，feel any better 说没感觉进步，直接问要不要停。

answers.en: A hundred-day streak and nothing to show for it. Is it worth continuing?
answers.note: nothing to show for it 指白忙一场，语气最泄气，适合跟一起学的朋友说。

answers.en: Should I keep going? A hundred days in and I still can't see the progress.
answers.note: 先问还要不要继续，再说看不到进步，语气犹豫，适合征求朋友意见。
